anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: They do not know what they are doing; it is forgiven.
Quoted sense: it is good that one man die for the people.
It is not permitted that a prophet die outside Jerusalem.
Jerusalem: vision of peace — possible in the gloss 'peace and righteousness'.

pass_a_gloss: For the sacrificing of this one, the one through them, was happening in ignorance because of them not knowing what they do — hence it is also forgiven them. For it is good that one human die over the whole people. For it is not permitted a prophet to die outside Jerusalem, that is of those trying to dwell upon peace and righteousness.
pass_b_english: For the sacrificing of this one, which was through them, was taking place in ignorance, because they did not know what they were doing — hence it is also forgiven them. For it is good that one human being die for the whole people. For it is not permitted that a prophet die outside Jerusalem — that is, of those who try to dwell in peace and righteousness (Luke 23:34) (John 11:50) (Luke 13:33) (Acts 3:17) (Hebrews 7:2).
source_text: Ἡ γὰρ τούτου θύσις ἡ δι’ αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγνοίᾳ ἐγίνετο διὰ τὸ μὴ αὐτοὺς γινώσκειν ὃ ποιοῦσιν – ἔνθεν καὶ ἀφίεται αὐτοῖς –· καλὸν γὰρ ἕνα ἄν(θρωπ)ον ἀποθανεῖν ὑπὲρ ὅλου τοῦ λαοῦ. Οὐ γὰρ ἐξὸν προφήτην|| ἔξω Ἰ(ερουσα)λὴμ ἀποθανεῖν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τῶν ἐπὶ εἰρήνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνοικεῖν πειρωμένων.
